subject: King crab
topic: This spiky crab is a king crab, and it hides a surprising family secret.
script:
This spiky crab is a king crab, and it hides a surprising family secret.
King crabs evolved from hermit crabs.
Over millions of years, their ancestors gave up living in borrowed shells.
You can still see a clue: a king crab's belly flap is lopsided, just like a hermit crab's.
And while most crabs walk on eight legs, king crabs seem to have only six, with a tiny pair tucked away.
This one, more than two kilometers down, was rocking its body back and forth in the mud.
Off North Carolina, another was caught feasting on a brittle star.
Would you have guessed it's a hermit crab in disguise?
